turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. The attached picture is the MAN; he must look exactly like this, same face, hair, moustache and suit, in colour. He stands on a foreground rock ledge, seen from the side, looking out over this place: A vivid turquoise lake fills the lower half, darkening to blue beneath shadows at the far left shore. A towering wall of jagged gray mountains spans the background, with sheer, horizontally layered cliffs, pale scree slopes, and narrow patches of snow in gullies and beneath summits. Dense dark-green conifers cover the curving right shoreline and climb the hillside, extending toward the distant center. Small docks and colorful boats sit along the lower right bank. Rough, angular gray rock slabs form a foreground ledge across the bottom, beside a tall slender evergreen on the left. Bright daytime sunlight illuminates the lake and right-hand forest beneath a blue sky streaked with soft white clouds. Beside his feet on the ledge sits this pot: A squat, thick-walled stone pot, roughly one-and-a-half times wider than tall, with a broad circular mouth, rounded rim, nearly straight sides and flat base. The surface is weathered grey-brown with pale beige edges and darker recesses; the interior is rough and undecorated. Beneath the rim runs a narrow band of deeply cut alternating triangles. The broad middle band is divided by vertical toothed borders into rectangular panels filled with angular triangles and intersecting diagonal grooves. The front-right panel contains a large four-lobed motif outlined by several concentric grooves. A second triangular border circles the bottom above a plain foot edge. One short, solid, flattened rectangular lug projects horizontally from the upper right side; no open spout. He is the only person.

must_haves: The man is recognisably the man in the attached portrait.

style.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic color still photograph, widescreen 16:9, no text, no lettering, no watermark. Use the attached portrait as the strict identity and clothing reference for the ONLY person. Preserve precisely his recognizable elderly face, unruly wavy white hair, thick white drooping moustache, facial proportions, and the same light ivory suit jacket, waistcoat and high-collared white shirt. Colorize naturally. Show him full body standing on a foreground rock ledge in side / three-quarter profile looking across the lake, face still visible and recognizable, not facing the viewer. Natural anatomically correct proportions. The man occupies the left-center foreground, with the magnificent landscape clearly visible around him. A vivid turquoise alpine lake fills the lower half of the landscape, darkening to blue in shadows along the far left shore. A towering continuous wall of jagged gray mountains spans the background: sheer horizontally layered cliffs, pale scree slopes, narrow patches of snow in gullies and below summits. Dense dark-green conifers follow the curving right shoreline and climb the right hillside toward the distant center. Small docks and colorful boats along the lower right bank, no people. Rough angular gray rock slabs form the foreground ledge across the bottom. A tall slender evergreen stands at the left edge. Bright daytime sunlight illuminates the lake and right forest under blue sky streaked with soft white clouds. Beside the man's feet, fully visible on the ledge, place a single squat thick-walled carved stone pot, approximately 1.5 times wider than tall. Give the pot a broad circular open mouth, rounded thick rim, nearly straight sides and flat base; weathered grey-brown stone with pale beige edges and dark recesses, rough plain interior. Its carved exterior must be detailed: a narrow deeply cut alternating triangle band beneath the rim; a broad middle band divided into rectangular panels by vertical toothed borders, with angular triangles and intersecting diagonal grooves filling the panels; on its front-right panel a large four-lobed motif outlined with several concentric grooves. A second triangle border circles the bottom just above a plain foot edge. ONE short solid flattened rectangular lug projects horizontally from the pot's upper right side. No open spout, no loop handle. Frame pot large enough to read its carved geometry while retaining the expansive mountain vista. Realistic camera photography, coherent scale, crisp natural textures, consistent sunlight and contact shadows. Only one man, no other people, no duplicated objects, no illustrations.
